comparisons.peer_topic: Impact of Pillar Two on company's 2024 financials
comparisons.peer_summary: The impact of Pillar Two legislation on the company for the fiscal year 2024 was immaterial, and the company continues to evaluate the impact of proposed and enacted legislative changes on its effective tax rate and cash flows as new guidance becomes available.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose the impact of OECD Pillar Two on their effective tax rates. Intel lists 'changes in US federal, state, or foreign tax laws... including the global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two' as a factor causing variability in its tax rate and cash payments. In contrast, AMD explicitly states that for fiscal year 2024, the impact of Pillar Two was 'immaterial' to them, though they continue to evaluate legislative changes.

sentences.text: A number of factors can impact our future effective tax rate or cash payments, which could cause significant variability in our financial results, including:
▪changes in US federal, state, or foreign tax laws or their interpretation, including the global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two of the OECD BEPS initiative;
For 2024, the impact to us associated with Pillar Two was immaterial.
We continue to evaluate the impact of proposed and enacted legislative changes to our effective tax rate and cash flows as new guidance becomes available.

comparisons.peer_topic: OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax implementation status
comparisons.peer_summary: The OECD is continuing discussions on profit allocation and global minimum tax (Pillar One and Two), with the EU having adopted the 15% minimum tax for member states and many other countries implementing laws with effective dates starting in 2024, though some jurisdictions where the company operates have not yet adopted corresponding legislation.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies discuss the implementation status of OECD Pillar Two. Intel identifies the global implementation of Pillar Two as a specific risk factor for tax rate variability. AMD provides more detail on the legislative landscape, noting that while the EU adopted the 15% minimum tax and many countries implemented laws effective in 2024, Intel does not specify the 2024 effective date for its operations, focusing instead on the risk of change. AMD notes that certain jurisdictions where it operates have not yet adopted corresponding legislation.

sentences.text: ▪changes in US federal, state, or foreign tax laws or their interpretation, including the global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two of the OECD BEPS initiative;
The Council of the European Union has adopted the global corporate 15% minimum tax as provided for in Pillar Two and has directed EU member states to implement legislation enacting Pillar Two.
Many countries, including non-EU member states, have implemented laws based on Pillar Two proposals, with effective dates that started in 2024.

Although many countries have already introduced Pillar Two legislation applicable to us effective in 2024, certain jurisdictions in which we operate have not adopted corresponding legislation to date.

comparisons.peer_summary: Significant management judgment is required to determine income tax provisions, deferred tax assets/liabilities, and valuation allowances, considering future taxable income and tax planning strategies.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom discuss the estimation of income taxes, specifically regarding deferred tax assets, liabilities, and valuation allowances. Intel lists 'changes in the valuation of our deferred tax assets and liabilities, and in deferred tax valuation allowances' as a key factor impacting effective tax rate variability. Broadcom similarly states that 'significant management judgment is required' to determine these provisions and allowances, considering future taxable income and tax planning strategies.

sentences.text: ▪changes in the valuation of our deferred tax assets and liabilities, and in deferred tax valuation allowances;

Significant management judgment is required in developing our provision for or benefit from income taxes, including the determination of deferred tax assets and liabilities and any valuation allowances that might be required against the deferred tax assets.
We have considered projected future taxable income and ongoing prudent and feasible tax planning strategies in assessing the need for valuation allowances.

comparisons.peer_topic: OECD Pillar Two Tax Legislation Impact
comparisons.peer_summary: The OECD Pillar Two legislation is effective for the company in 2025 and is expected not to materially impact the 2025 effective tax rate. However, other countries including Singapore plan to adopt similar legislation effective in 2026, which would significantly increase tax expense.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron discuss the impact of OECD Pillar Two legislation on their effective tax rates. Intel includes 'global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two' as a factor causing variability in tax results. Micron states that while enacted laws (EU) are effective in 2025 and do not expect a material impact on the 2025 effective tax rate, additional countries like Singapore will adopt similar legislation in 2026, which 'significantly increase[s] our tax expense.'

sentences.text: ▪changes in US federal, state, or foreign tax laws or their interpretation, including the global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two of the OECD BEPS initiative;

While we do not expect these enacted laws to materially impact our effective tax rate for 2025, additional countries where we operate, including Singapore, have announced plans to adopt Pillar Two legislation.
Enactment of this legislation would become effective for us in 2026 and significantly increase our tax expense.

comparisons.peer_topic: Income Tax Rate Changes and Losses
comparisons.peer_summary: The effective tax rate change in 2024 was driven by profitability changes, while the 2023 change resulted from a pre-tax loss. Despite a worldwide consolidated pre-tax loss in 2023, taxes were payable in certain geographies due to minimum taxable income reporting requirements.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron identify 'changes in the volume and mix of profits' (profitability) as a driver of effective tax rate variability. Intel lists 'changes in the volume and mix of profits earned and location of assets' as a factor impacting the tax rate. Micron explicitly states that the change in its effective tax rate for 2024 was 'primarily due to changes in profitability.'

sentences.text: ▪changes in the volume and mix of profits earned and location of assets across jurisdictions with varying tax rates;
The change in our effective tax rate for 2024 as compared to 2023 was primarily due to changes in profitability.

comparisons.peer_topic: OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax
comparisons.peer_summary: While Pillar Two legislation has been enacted in certain jurisdictions effective for fiscal year 2025, NVIDIA does not expect a material impact on its effective tax rate or cash flows in the next fiscal year based on current enacted laws, though new guidance could change this assessment.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA discuss the impact of OECD Pillar Two on their effective tax rates. Intel lists the 'global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two' as a factor that could cause significant variability in financial results. NVIDIA states that based on enacted laws, Pillar Two is 'not expected to materially impact our effective tax rate or cash flows in the next fiscal year,' though it acknowledges that new guidance could change this assessment.

sentences.text: ▪changes in US federal, state, or foreign tax laws or their interpretation, including the global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two of the OECD BEPS initiative;
Based on enacted laws, Pillar Two is not expected to materially impact our effective tax rate or cash flows in the next fiscal year.
New legislation or guidance could change our current assessment.

comparisons.peer_topic: Income tax uncertainty and liability recognition
comparisons.peer_summary: The company is subject to income taxes in U.S. and foreign jurisdictions, requiring estimates and judgments for deferred tax assets and liabilities that may change based on uncertainties in tax laws or anticipated outcomes. Liabilities for potential income tax contingencies are recognized based on estimates of additional taxes due, with any necessary adjustments for benefits or expenses recorded in financial statements.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA discuss the uncertainty and estimation involved in calculating deferred tax assets and liabilities. Intel cites 'changes in the valuation of our deferred tax assets and liabilities' as a factor impacting tax rate variability. NVIDIA explains that its calculation of deferred tax assets and liabilities is based on 'estimates and judgments' and 'involves dealing with uncertainties in the application of complex tax laws,' and these estimates may change based on outcomes or law changes.

sentences.text: ▪changes in the valuation of our deferred tax assets and liabilities, and in deferred tax valuation allowances;
Our calculation of deferred tax assets and liabilities is based on certain estimates and judgments and involves dealing with uncertainties in the application of complex tax laws.

Our estimates of deferred tax assets and liabilities may change based, in part, on added certainty or finality to an anticipated outcome, changes in accounting standards or tax laws in the U.S. or foreign jurisdictions where we operate, or changes in other facts or circumstances.

comparisons.peer_topic: OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax Impact
comparisons.peer_summary: The OECD announced a framework for a 15% global minimum tax (Pillar Two), with legislation in certain countries set to apply to the company starting in fiscal year 2025. QCOM does not currently expect a material impact on consolidated financial statements but continues to monitor implementation and OECD guidance.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Qualcomm discuss the impact of OECD Pillar Two legislation. Intel lists 'global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two' as a factor impacting effective tax rate variability. Qualcomm notes that Pillar Two legislation will apply to it beginning in fiscal year 2025 and that while it does not currently expect a material impact on consolidated financial statements, it continues to monitor the impact.

sentences.text: ▪changes in US federal, state, or foreign tax laws or their interpretation, including the global implementation of a minimum tax under Pillar Two of the OECD BEPS initiative;
Certain countries have implemented or are in the process of implementing the Pillar Two legislation, which will apply to us beginning in fiscal year 2025.

While we do not currently expect this to materially impact our consolidated financial statements, we continue to monitor the impact as countries implement legislation and the OECD provides additional guidance.
